The stand-alone exact-rational checker verifies full matrices for n=2..6 and tests limiting scales, without claiming finite proof of infinity.

value.rationale: This fully classifies the covariance geometry of the natural uniform-vertex distribution on a canonical n-dimensional polytope family, determining a sharp cubic isotropy defect and an explicit coalescing-orbit discontinuity under Hausdorff-continuous degeneration.
